title: 永春堂 Yong Chun Tang
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.7 m, eave 4.4 m, ridge 8.76 m above the ground
hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 5 bays, the middle widest, a porch front and back, steps on the back, front, right, 歇山 hip-and-gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 张宝章: 敷春堂 renamed 永春堂 under Daoguang
evidence.summary: After the repair of 1821-22, Daoguang is said to have renamed 敷春堂 to 永春堂 as the Empress Dowager's bedroom hall. No document cited.: 1832, 1856 and 1873 still write 敷春堂.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 永春堂, 4x1 cells.
